context.transcript:
We have some exciting news.
Next month, our local Pine Valley supermarket will join the national Apex family of grocers.
This means incredible new benefits for you, our loyal customers.
In our all-new mobile application, you'll find dozens of digital coupons each week.
You can also shop from the convenience of your own home with our enhanced delivery service.
Receive half off the delivery fee on any order over $100.
context.transcript_translation:
我们有一些令人兴奋的消息。
下个月，我们当地的 Pine Valley 超市将加入全国 Apex 连锁超市大家庭。
这意味着对您这些忠实顾客带来了不可思议的新福利。
在我们的全新移动应用程序中，您每周都能找到数十张电子优惠券。
您还可以通过增强的送货服务，从自己家中购物。
任何超过 100 美元的订单，运费可享受半价。
